metadata.title: Setup Supabase Authentication with Capacitor Social Login Plugin
metadata.description: Learn how to integrate Supabase authentication with the Capgo Social Login plugin for seamless Google, Apple, and Facebook authentication in your Capacitor app.
metadata.author: Martin Donadieu
metadata.head_image_alt: 'Setup Supabase Authentication with Capacitor Social Login Plugin' Capgo blog illustration
metadata.keywords: Supabase, Capacitor, social login, authentication, Google, Apple, Facebook, mobile app development, OAuth
